verdict.rationale: Glama Chat provides a natural-language conversational interface (asking questions, uploading docs, generating diagrams/math, comparing model responses) which supports NL-driven interaction, but the core MCP hosting/gateway/registry operations are configured via manual JSON edits, Dockerfiles, and UI panels rather than natural-language commands. missing for 10: evidence that MCP hosting, gateway routing, or per-tool access control can be driven by NL commands rather than manual config/UI.
